transcript.text: indesit oven stoped heating, fan goes round n light on but its stone cold after 20 mins. grill werks fine tho. any ideas b4 i call some1 out

Since the grill works, the main power supply is likely fine. The issue probably lies with a faulty heating element or thermostat specific to the oven cavity. From what you have described, the most likely cause is which function works (fan/grill/top/base) - identify first. Some cookers won't heat until the clock is set or manual mode is selected after a power cut. Was the clock flashing or an auto mode set (and have you set it to manual), or was it already in manual mode?
its in manual, time is set n nothing flashing. also heard a little pop from inside the back last time it worked if that helps

Check the grill function is selected and the grill control turned up, and the door position is right — many grills need the door open, some (in an oven) closed; the manual says which. Was the setting or door position wrong (and have you changed it), or was it all set correctly?
the grill is fine, it gets red hot. its the main fan oven setting that gives no heat at all, any temp. nothing tripped either
Can you tell me whether top browns but base doesn't?
its a single oven, no separate top n base. only the grill heats, the main fan oven setting gives nothing. the orange light stays on tho

[Heading: Likely cause: fan oven element]
The checks point to the fan oven element. To find the right part, could you give me the model number? It is usually on the frame around the oven door opening.
